methods.name: Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN)
methods.protocol_description: A deep neural network approximates density, velocity, and pressure. The loss function combines a data loss (e.g., initial/boundary conditions) and a physics loss (mean squared error of the Euler equation residual). Training points are randomly scattered, with clustering around discontinuities. Automatic differentiation is used to compute derivatives.
